name: Empanada Kitchen
notes: All 3 photos were legible printed menus. Photo 1 (Empanada Kitchen) and photo 2 (a 'Ferlini' branded sheet at the same address with identical items) agree exactly on empanada, deal, and dessert prices, so photo 1 was used as the primary source. Photo 3 is a differently-priced revision of the same menu (empanadas 3.65 vs 5.30, renamed items, Lamb at 4.50) and was not merged in to avoid conflicting prices for the same dishes; it added no dish not already covered.

dishes.name: Beef
dishes.description: Ground beef, onion, red bell pepper, green onion, olives. The most traditional filling, not ideal for vegetarians.

dishes.name: Chicken

dishes.name: Lamb
